entries.speaker: Haru's Fiancé
entries.en: Now, why don't you come... to my place?

entries.speaker: Haru's Fiancé
entries.en: Let's have fun! I'll play with you until I get bored!

entries.speaker: Haru's Fiancé
entries.en: A high school fiancée... What a turn-on!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: So vulgar...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No! Haru's Persona won't stand a chance against that—

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Don't worry!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: She hadn't awakened to her real power, that's all!

entries.speaker: Haru's Fiancé
entries.en: How dare you!

entries.speaker: Milady
entries.en: I see you finally made up your mind... my dear, fated princess.

entries.speaker: Milady
entries.en: Freedom for you must stem from betrayal.

entries.speaker: Milady
entries.en: If you still yearn for it now... then you must not err.

entries.speaker: Milady
entries.en: Now, tell me... Who shall you betray?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: My heart has been set... You should know.

entries.speaker: Milady
entries.en: Yes, that gaze...! I can finally display my true strength.

entries.speaker: Milady
entries.en: I am thou, thou art I...

entries.speaker: Milady
entries.en: Let us adorn your departure into freedom with a beautiful betrayal.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Geez!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Farewell, dear Father.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I am no longer your subservient puppet!

entries.speaker: Shadow Okumura
entries.en: Then so be it... You're worthless.

entries.speaker: Shadow Okumura
entries.en: Hmph. Deal with them how you wish.

entries.speaker: Haru's Fiancé
entries.en: You poor thing... I'll toy with you until you break!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I don't expect you to come to reason at all.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh-huh. We shoulda just told you this from the start, asshat.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We are the Phantom Thieves, here to take your bride!
